chat_conversations.mine.title: My conversations
chat_conversations.mine.description: Lists the caller's conversations on their side: pinned first, then by the latest message; single chats show the peer's user name.
chat_conversations.members.title: Conversation members
chat_conversations.members.description: Lists the members of a conversation by role and join time; members only.
chat_conversations.read_positions.title: Read positions
chat_conversations.read_positions.descri: Lists the message and sequence number each member has read up to, for read receipts; members only.
chat_conversations.department_tree.title: Department tree
chat_conversations.department_tree.descr: Lists the enabled departments on the caller's side as a tree for opening department chats; the platform has no departments.
chat_conversations.user_options.title: User options
chat_conversations.user_options.descript: Pages through active accounts on the caller's side by keyword and department (including its descendants), with each user's primary department, for starting chats and adding members: platform accounts on the platform, home users and members in a tenant.
chat_conversations.open_single.title: Open single chat
chat_conversations.open_single.descripti: Opens the single chat with a peer, creating it if missing; a pair has one single chat per side and the peer must belong to the caller's side.
chat_conversations.create_group.title: Create group chat
chat_conversations.create_group.descript: Creates a group chat with the caller as owner and at least two members on the caller's side, posting a system notice to the members.
chat_conversations.open_department.title: Open department chat
chat_conversations.open_department.descr: Opens a department chat, creating it and adding the department's members if missing; only members of the department may enter and it has no owner or administrators.
chat_conversations.add_members.title: Add group members
chat_conversations.add_members.descripti: Adds users to a group chat; group chats only, owner or administrator, new members must belong to the caller's side.
chat_conversations.remove_members.title: Remove group members
chat_conversations.remove_members.descri: Removes members from a group chat; group chats only, owner or administrator; non-members, the owner and the caller fail per item.
chat_conversations.leave.title: Leave group chat
chat_conversations.leave.description: Leaves a group chat; group chats only, the owner must transfer ownership first.
chat_conversations.update_info.title: Update chat info
chat_conversations.update_info.descripti: Updates the name, announcement, description and avatar; owner or administrator, department chats keep their name, a new announcement is posted in the operator's name.
chat_conversations.transfer_owner.title: Transfer ownership
chat_conversations.transfer_owner.descri: Transfers ownership to another member; group chats only, by the owner, who becomes a regular member.
chat_conversations.silence_members.title: Silence members
chat_conversations.silence_members.descr: Silences or unsilences members; owner or administrator of a group or department chat; non-members, the owner and administrators fail per item.
chat_conversations.set_member_role.title: Set member role
chat_conversations.set_member_role.descr: Switches a member between administrator and regular member; group chats only, by the owner.
chat_conversations.pin.title: Pin conversation
chat_conversations.pin.description: Pins or unpins a conversation for the caller only, synced to their other devices.
chat_conversations.mute.title: Mute conversation
chat_conversations.mute.description: Mutes or unmutes a conversation for the caller only, synced to their other devices.
chat_conversations.mark_read.title: Mark as read
chat_conversations.mark_read.description: Clears the unread count and moves the read position forward (never back; to the latest when no message is given), pushed to all members.
chat_messages.history.title: Message history
chat_messages.history.description: Returns a page of messages by sequence (before a message or around one), with reactions; members only.
chat_messages.search.title: Search messages
chat_messages.search.description: Searches a conversation's text and attachment names, excluding recalled messages, newest first; members only.
chat_messages.pinned.title: Pinned messages
chat_messages.pinned.description: Lists a conversation's pinned messages, most recently pinned first; members only.
chat_messages.send.title: Send message
chat_messages.send.description: Sends a text, image, voice or file message; members not silenced; checks sensitive words, attachment ownership, mentions and replies, then pushes it to all members.
chat_messages.recall.title: Recall message
chat_messages.recall.description: Recalls the caller's own message within 2 minutes, clearing its text and keeping the row and attachments.
chat_messages.edit.title: Edit message
chat_messages.edit.description: Edits the caller's own text message within 5 minutes, if not silenced and free of sensitive words.
chat_messages.react.title: React to message
chat_messages.react.description: Toggles an emoji reaction on a message; reacting again with the same emoji removes it; members only.
chat_messages.pin.title: Pin message
chat_messages.pin.description: Pins a message; both sides in single chats, owner or administrators otherwise, up to 10 per conversation.
chat_messages.unpin.title: Unpin message
chat_messages.unpin.description: Unpins a message with the same rules as pinning.
chat_messages.forward.title: Forward message
chat_messages.forward.description: Forwards a message to one or more conversations, copying its type, text and attachments without a forwarded-from mark; assistant replies go out as text; each conversation succeeds or fails on its own.
chat_messages.fast_upload.title: Fast upload attachment
chat_messages.fast_upload.description: Reuses a file with the same content on the caller's side as a chat attachment, or returns empty so the client uploads normally; needs only the chat send permission.
chat_messages.presign.title: Attachment URL
chat_messages.presign.description: Signs a download URL for an attachment for a conversation member; the file must appear in the conversation or be the caller's own unsent chat upload.
chat_audit.list.title: Audit chat messages
chat_audit.list.description: Pages through every message on the caller's side without membership; filters by conversation, sender, type, time and recall state, excluding recalled messages by default.
chat_audit.get.title: Audit message details
chat_audit.get.description: Returns a message with its conversation, attachments, mentions, reply and reactions; recalled or edited text is not kept.
chat_audit.members.title: Audit conversation members
chat_audit.members.description: Lists a conversation and its current members without membership.

jobs.chat.messages.cleanup.title: Chat message retention
jobs.chat.messages.cleanup.description: Deletes chat messages older than the retention period with their reactions (days from the platform setting chat.policy), separately for the platform and each tenant; conversations and attachment files are kept.
openapi.groups.chat.name: Chat
openapi.groups.chat.description: Single, group and department chats: conversations, messages, attachments and chat audit.
openapi.tags.chat_conversations.name: Chat conversations
openapi.tags.chat_conversations.descript: My conversations, single, group and department chats, group governance and personal settings.
openapi.tags.chat_messages.name: Chat messages
openapi.tags.chat_messages.description: Message history and search; sending, recalling, editing, reacting, pinning, forwarding and attachments.
openapi.tags.chat_audit.name: Chat audit
openapi.tags.chat_audit.description: Messages, message details and conversation members on the caller's side without membership.
permissions.chat.chat_conversations.read: List and open the caller's conversations, read members and read positions, leave, pin, mute and mark conversations as read.
permissions.chat.chat_conversations.mana: Create group chats and govern them as owner or administrator: members, info, announcement, owner, roles and silencing.
permissions.chat.chat_messages.read.name: Read chat messages
permissions.chat.chat_messages.read.desc: Read the history, search and pinned messages of conversations the caller belongs to, and sign their attachments.
permissions.chat.chat_messages.send.name: Send chat messages
permissions.chat.chat_messages.send.desc: Send, recall, edit, react to, pin, forward messages and upload attachments in conversations the caller belongs to.
permissions.chat.chat_audit.read.name: Audit chat messages
permissions.chat.chat_audit.read.descrip: Search every message on the caller's side, view message details and conversation members without being a member.
chat_conversations.assistants.title: List available assistants
chat_conversations.assistants.descriptio: List the assistants available in chat. Reports assistants as unavailable when the AI module is not installed.
chat_conversations.open_assistant.title: Open an assistant conversation
chat_conversations.open_assistant.descri: Open the conversation with an assistant. A user has one conversation per assistant; it is created with the greeting if missing.
chat_messages.reply_assistant.title: Request an assistant reply
chat_messages.reply_assistant.descriptio: Reply to the latest question in the conversation. Deltas are pushed to you in real time and the result is saved as an assistant message; tools run as the caller.
chat.assistant.not_assistant: This conversation is not an assistant conversation.
chat.assistant.no_question: There is no question to answer in this conversation.
chat_calls.start.title: Start call
chat_calls.start.description: Starts a voice or video call in a direct conversation and begins ringing; refused when either side is already in a call or the other side is offline.
chat_calls.accept.title: Accept call
chat_calls.accept.description: Accepts an incoming call that is still ringing; when several devices accept at once only the first succeeds.
chat_calls.reject.title: Reject call
chat_calls.reject.description: Rejects an incoming call that is still ringing; the call ends and leaves a record in the conversation.
chat_calls.hangup.title: Hang up call
chat_calls.hangup.description: Hangs up a call: the initiator hanging up before it is answered cancels it, either side hanging up afterwards ends it; a call that has already ended still succeeds.
chat_calls.active.title: Current call
chat_calls.active.description: Returns the call the caller is in right now (ringing or ongoing), or nothing.
chat_calls.ice_servers.title: Call ICE servers
chat_calls.ice_servers.description: Returns the STUN and TURN servers used to connect a call; the TURN credential is issued for the caller and expires.
openapi.tags.chat_calls.name: Chat calls
openapi.tags.chat_calls.description: Voice and video calls in direct conversations: start, accept, reject, hang up, the current call and ICE servers.
permissions.chat.chat_calls.read.name: Read chat calls
permissions.chat.chat_calls.read.descrip: See the call the caller is currently in and get the ICE servers used to connect it.
permissions.chat.chat_calls.call.name: Make voice and video calls
permissions.chat.chat_calls.call.descrip: Start, accept, reject and hang up voice and video calls in conversations the caller belongs to.
chat.call.single_only: Calls can only be started in direct conversations.
chat.call.record_locked: A call record cannot be recalled.
chat.call.not_participant: You are not a participant in this call.
chat.call.caller_busy: You are already in another call. Hang up that one first.
chat.call.callee_busy: The other person is in a call. Try again later.
chat.call.callee_offline: The other person is offline and cannot answer right now.
chat.call.not_ringing: This call has already been answered or has ended.
jobs.chat.calls.sweep.title: Chat call sweep
jobs.chat.calls.sweep.description: Marks calls that rang out as missed and ends ringing calls whose initiator went offline and ongoing calls with a dropped participant; runs for the platform and each tenant separately.
